Statement

Step 3. By the primitive spectral theorem, we decompose \(U_{01270013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the primitive spectral family.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via nonlinear interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01270011 \cdot C_01270012 \cdot C_01270013\).
